learning_outcomes.text: Think in terms of a book of positions rather than single trades
Explain return, volatility and correlation at the portfolio level
Diversify across instruments and strategies to reduce concentration
Allocate capital across setups with a repeatable method
Measure aggregate exposure and hedge correlated risk
Track performance, attribute results and rebalance with rules

integrative_case: A trader running several setups at once wants a coherent book: measure total portfolio heat, allocate capital across uncorrelated strategies, hedge a concentrated exposure, and set rules for attribution, rebalancing and cutting a strategy that stops working.
